sourceRule: Root variant=default|destructive and size=default|sm only style div content. Content is native pre with nested code, dir=ltr and tabIndex0; wrap defaultsfalse, lineNumbersfalse, startLine1 controls the CSS line counter. With string children and numbering, one trailing newline is removed before splitting; empty CodeBlockLine deliberately emits a newline. No syntax highlighter or executable code engine is built in. CopyButton requires value:string, defaults ghost/icon-xs, calls caller onClick before navigator.clipboard.writeText(value), and does not inspect defaultPrevented. Successful promise sets copied=true, aria-label=Copied and a polite live text; first copied=true schedules reset after2000ms. Repeated success while already copied does not restart that effect timer. Rejected promises are swallowed, preserving the previous copied state; no onCopied/onCopyError event exists. Missing navigator.clipboard can throw synchronously before the promise catch. This reference requires a supported secure clipboard context for Copy and provides persistent native text-selection instructions as the fallback. The copy value is exact caller text, not inferred from formatted/numbered DOM.
keyboardAndFocus: Native Copy Button supports Enter/Space; disabled suppresses its click. The focusable pre supports native selection/scrolling and Tab leaves it. Escape does not revert code or cancel a clipboard write already requested. Copy does not move focus. A descriptive code heading/instructions are caller supplied, not automatic CodeBlockTitle semantics.

protocol: SCXML projects observed actual source/native transactions. Public callback names/payloads are real; _effect.* entries identify internal browser/primitive effects.
